_how: Event-log digests of the pinned runs (tests/test_sim.gd GOLDEN_RUNS). The Windows tests and the Linux demo (tests/run_sim.gd --golden) must both reproduce them: the same seed gives the same history on every machine. 'memory off' runs are Pilot 1's histories, pinned before memory existed and unchanged by Pilot 2; 'memory on' runs are Pilot 2's, pinned from the Windows run of commit 8d67289; 'crime on' runs are Pilot 3A's (a month, so that thefts happen), pinned from the Windows run of commit d885ed1, which Linux reproduced. Pilot 3A's crime switch is off by default, so the six earlier histories are unchanged by it. Since Pilot 3B, crime on means the whole crime layer; Pilot 3A's three histories are its 'crime on, violence off' runs, relabelled with their digests unchanged, and 'crime on' runs are Pilot 3B's (a month in the tension season, seeds 1 and 3, and in the crisis season, seed 1, long enough for fights, falls and collisions), pinned from the Windows runs of commits a04bd1b to 1949473 (CI runs 38-42), which all gave the same three digests. The grocery deadlock fix (shop workers serve themselves when nobody else is serving, and buy for their household during their shift; a deliberate difference from Python) changed all twelve, because shop workers buy during their shifts from the first week in every one of them. The twelve digests pinned before it are kept under the same keys marked "Python's shop rule" and are reproduced with "shop_self_service": false, the separate check that the fix changed nothing else; the plain keys hold the histories with the fix, pinned after the Windows tests and the Linux demo produced the same twelve digests in CI run 46. With the fix, the three full-crime months hold only a fall between them, so two more are pinned with it, chosen because violence happens in them (seed 2 tension: three collisions, two driven on from, a quiet repair; seed 4 tension: a fight), from CI run 47, where both platforms agreed. A deliberate change to the simulation's rules changes them; update them in the same commit and say why.
